### Material update after the 24 October DEV reset
Commit a18726c adds optional issued UPMRN (contract syntax) to patient-only intake and the atomic registration payload. **This proposal covers tested patient-only POST /patients only; atomic UPMRN registration is still pending testing.** Duplicate PATIENT_CNIC_EXISTS / PATIENT_UPMRN_EXISTS now show “This patient is already registered: search for them instead” and a deliberate returning-patient search action, with no automatic write.

Changed: src/screens/Registration.tsx, src/generated/registration.ts, bilingual src/registration-help.ts and src/foundation-help.ts; refreshed MCP contracts and fresh English/Urdu screenshots.

`npm run build` PASS: 30 screens, 554 controls, TypeScript/Vite. `npm test` 66 PASS. `node scripts/patient-identifiers-reset-check.mjs` PASS on real DEV: new synthetic patients 1 and 2 in the NEW reset epoch; UPMRN present/omitted, invalid-pattern no POST, rapid submit one record, actual duplicate CNIC/UPMRN refusals, explicit search finds existing patient, F1 draft/focus, both themes/languages at 250%. Preferences restored/logout. Evidence: docs/patient-identifiers-reset-evidence-2026-10-24.json.

Earlier accepted unchanged rules are not proposed again. Human fresh-data journey, native Urdu and physical print/editor review remain pending. This is not a whole-screen completion claim.

### Updated patient identifier contracts and edit recovery
Commit a18726c regenerates the MCP patient types/search function; profile/editor displays, edits and clears optional UPMRN. Error handling uses error.code: duplicate UPMRN/CNIC preserves an editable draft; VERSION_CONFLICT and unknown outcomes require current-record reconciliation; PATIENT_TYPE_TRANSITION_INVALID has specific guidance and cancels the invalid upgrade flag. Only changed fields and original expected_version are PATCHed; no automatic replay.

Changed: src/screens/PatientSearch.tsx, src/patient-errors.ts, src/generated/patient_search.ts and affected generated-search callers; bilingual control help/contracts and fresh EN/UR screenshots.

`npm run build` PASS; `npm test` 66 PASS (includes production-helper definitive-refusal/unknown-outcome tests). Real DEV Electron `node scripts/patient-identifiers-reset-check.mjs` PASS: new reset-epoch synthetic patients 1/2, exact MRN/UPMRN search and detail reads, duplicate UPMRN refusal then deliberate correction/save/readback/clear, genuine concurrent PATCH causes VERSION_CONFLICT, draft retained and save locked, explicit read/compare/reload; backend Regular-to-Regular upgrade returns PATIENT_TYPE_TRANSITION_INVALID. Both themes/languages at 250% no overflow. Evidence: docs/patient-identifiers-reset-evidence-2026-10-24.json. Preferences restored/logout.

No unchanged accepted merge/event claims resubmitted. Full fresh-reset test plan, merge event, human journey/translation/native printing/editor review still pending; no q:tested or human-review item claimed.
